title: Discovery index (<kind>s/index.json)
description: The machine-checkable form of m053 section 6.2. The index carries no download URL and no checksum, so it can never decide what bytes install -- but latest_version and versions decide which version an unpinned install resolves to, which is why it is signed. The root validates shape alone; a validator selects #/$defs/submitted or #/$defs/published (section 6.7). An index is a generated artifact: the validator regenerates it from the manifests and fails if the committed file disagrees.

kind.description: The kind this index lists; must match the directory.

index_signature.description: Registry signature over the whole index. Written by CI at merge, never by the submitter.

submitted.description: A submission: the registry holds the signing key, so index_signature is forbidden.

published.description: The merged tree: CI has stamped the signature.

entry.description: One listed artifact. The generator owns everything derived from the manifests -- trust, author, pricing, versions, latest_version, updated_at -- and preserves the catalog fields, which describe the entry rather than any one version and have no other home in the layout.

name.description: Kebab-case identifier, unique within the kind.

license.description: SPDX identifier, or Proprietary for a commercial artifact.

repository.description: The source repository -- external and third-party-owned in the normal case, because the hub indexes rather than hosts. Every URL an entry sends a user to for bytes must be under the same owner as this one. That makes it the one carried-over entry field that decides something: repointing it is answered by rejecting the edit, since the manifests it is checked against are immutable once published.

latest_version.description: Must appear in versions and must not be yanked.

versions.description: All published versions, oldest first, including yanked ones.

screenshots.description: Themes and templates; rendered by the hub.
